preservation_constraints.requirement: Keep frozen technical baseline `native_godot_project` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

Keep frozen technical baseline `host_godot_boot` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

task_specification.objective: Deliver a release-testable Mournlight run with authoritative five-wave and Bellkeeper behavior, truthful authored animation and semantic audio, and package-safe cemetery presentation that remains readable and stable at representative density, while preserving the native Godot boot, current combat identities, UI hierarchy, and intact authored cemetery source.

diagnosis.root_cause: Release convergence is blocked by three owner-level defects: wave and boss behavior is split between duplicated definitions and a spawner that does not reconcile actors when a cap falls; presentation adapters report semantic animation and audio states while reusing one unrelated clip and a few firearm-derived recordings; and the preserved cemetery package is surrounded by ad-hoc root integration, weak depth/readability budgets, and high-churn systems that have not been qualified at representative density. The current 12-actor pool also cannot exercise the required 25–40-enemy performance surface.

stop_conditions: Stop if an edit breaks native import or host boot, produces recurring runtime errors, or invalidates the preserved movement, dash, automatic-combat, upgrade, or Retry behavior.

Do not represent missing Warden motion with speed changes, transforms, tinting, or an unrelated clip; stop and report the unavailable semantic asset surface if no compatible intact actor package can supply it.
Do not synthesize tones or reuse firearm recordings as semantic substitutes; stop the affected audio binding if a licensed, provenance-complete recording cannot be supplied.

Do not extract, duplicate, hide, or reposition children of the preserved cemetery package; if package-native root and wrapper repair cannot produce a valid arena, retain the package and report the integration blocker.
Stop performance tuning that changes target legality, damage causality, telegraph timing, cap enforcement, or pool reset correctness; preserve behavior and report the measured bottleneck instead.

strategy.rationale: Repair authoritative owners before presentation, replace semantic aliases with inspectable bindings, and treat the repeated cemetery defect through direct intact-package wrapper/material integration rather than another transform-tuning pass.
